purpose: Verified contract for regime-specific and time-specific interpretation of legal terms in Irish housing and property questions.
definition_rule: A legal term must be interpreted from the applicable governing regime and source before it is used in a legal conclusion.
scope_rule: A statutory definition applies only within the scope specified by its governing source.
temporal_rule: The definition applicable to a historical event must be verified for the relevant date, commencement and transitional framework.
collision_rule: Terms that appear similar in ordinary language may represent different legal concepts, including registered title, beneficial interest, possession, tenancy, security and burden.
case_rule: Judicial interpretation is linked to the actual interpretive proposition supported by the judgment.
guidance_rule: Official guidance may explain operational terminology but does not replace substantive statutory meaning.
verification_boundary: This resolver selects and scopes definitions; it does not independently establish the ultimate legal effect of the defined concept.
